subject: botany_2
question_text: Write briefly on the occurrence of micro organisms.

verification.note: Sourced from "Sr. Botany — My Baby Bullet-Q" (Sri Publishers, STAR-Q Pass Track), book p.41, printed question 72. Botany-II holds only ONE source book: the TSBIE Basic Learning Material in hand covers physics only, and no Telangana Botany-II board paper is in the corpus, so the two-book union check and the board back-test are BOTH structurally impossible for this card — "not checked" does NOT mean "checked and clean". Run both the moment a second source or a real paper arrives. The mark split is a claim until a Telangana IPE teacher confirms it.

insider_note: The word to reach for is omnipresent. Then give the extremes — that is what shows the range.

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: Where they occur
steps.margin_note: Habitats plus at least two extremes. Five lines.
lines: Micro organisms such as bacteria and viruses occur
They are found in soil, in water, in air, and
inside the bodies of other organisms.
They live in hot springs, in deserts, in deep
steps.why: Naming the extremes rather than the ordinary places is what shows the range is genuinely everywhere and not just everywhere convenient.
common_mistakes: Saying microbes live only in warm, wet places. They live in hot springs AND under snow.
Listing habitats without any extreme. The extremes are what make the answer.
steps.memory_tip: Hot springs to snow: nowhere is ruled out.

steps.label: What that means
steps.margin_note: Name the term, then one line on why it matters.
lines: Because they occur everywhere, micro organisms
This is why sterilisation is needed before any
steps.why: If microbes are everywhere then any surface or medium is already contaminated, which is why sterilisation comes first in every technique in this book.
common_mistakes: Leaving the word omnipresent out. It is the term the question is asking for.
Giving no consequence. The link to sterilisation makes the fact useful.
steps.memory_tip: Everywhere means every culture starts contaminated.
